suites.name: Diagnostic: distro baseline UTF-8 upstream unit tests
command:
mkdir -p /build/baseline-comparison
dpkg-source -x /originals/expat_2.5.0-1+deb12u5.dsc /build/baseline-comparison/source
cd /build/baseline-comparison/source
dpkg-buildpackage -b -us -uc -j1
dpkg-source --before-build .
status=0
make -C build/tests check || status=$?
if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then cat build/tests/test-suite.log; fi
exit "$status"
